WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_file_size_per_scan_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.chronotag::text > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND sc.chronotag::text < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_file_size_per_scan_minute) OVER () AS mean_status_average
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT
  healtheval,
  total_scans,
  avg_file_size_per_scan_minute,
  avg_file_size_per_scan_minute - mean_status_average AS difference_from_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_status_average IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The average ratio is computed per scan as gbsize divided by spanmin, excluding rows where either value is missing or spanmin is zero; the mean across statuses equally weights each non-NULL status-level average.
